text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three years with Ikuno Dictus come to 
an end. However, this is merely the 
beginning—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those hoofprints from "running longer than 
anyone else" will continue on endlessly 
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And people began to see it in her running. 
The prayer she carries, the world she 
strives for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A future full of races where nobody gets 
hurt—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you! I have duly received you and 
Ikuno Dictus's three-year operation log 
for the prototype management app and the 
proposal for future plans!!”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I watched your performance earlier, and it 
was truly... wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It was a record packed with the entire 
journey of Trainer and Ikuno Dictus... A 
true chronicle of their 'hoofprints.'

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Confirmation needed! Are you truly fine 
with this? Making your data and the 
management AI's growth widely available to 
the public!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a promise made with Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we can make it through these three 
years safely, I intend to share everything 
with the wider world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And by doing so, help create a future 
filled with races where no one gets hurt.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Understood! Then let us reveal all of 
this 『IRON WILL』 to the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What you and Ikuno Dictus wish for is the 
very ideal we strive for as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I pray! That this "will" shall 
lead to a brighter future for all 
Umamusume and everyone connected to them!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside my own materials 
summarizing "IRON WILL" and its 
applications—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three-year journey with Ikuno Dictus 
recorded in "IRON WILL" was published on a 
grand scale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it spread far beyond what I could have 
ever imagined—

text_block_list.name: Academy Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. It's finally time for your first 
graded race. Starting today, we'll adjust 
your training volume.

text_block_list.name: Academy Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I've put together a new training plan 
using the data from 'IRON WILL' as a 
reference, so please check it over first."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that... the thing Tracen Academy 
announced the other day?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 'IRON WILL'. It's amazing, you know? 
It keeps super detailed records of 
everything you did before a race, and—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how hard the racing Umamusume work 
day in and day out... It just moved me so 
much, I can't help watching.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sharing the "IRON WILL" seemed to be 
slowly but steadily making an impact on 
people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, as for me and Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――It has been a long time, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've been waiting for you, Ikuno-kun. 
You've certainly acquired an air of real 
dignity, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And... you must be Ikuno's Trainer. Well 
now, it's truly an honor to meet you.
choice_data_list: No, the pleasure was all mine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompanied Ikuno Dictus to visit 
her former teacher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started when Ikuno Dictus invited 
me to accompany her to deliver a report, 
marking the end of our three-year journey 
together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—The "IRON WILL" video you all released... 
I took the liberty of watching it too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"That is truly magnificent. I can feel 
your three years of unceasing effort and 
the resolute will embodied in your name—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it's also been helpful for my 
own work. The management support AI offers 
excellent suggestions, and there's a great 
deal of valuable reference data.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"IRON WILL will undeniably change the 
racing world for the better from here on 
out."
choice_data_list: I'm humbled to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you two really are quite similar. 
Maybe that's why, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I believe this feat could never have been 
achieved if either one of you had been 
missing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's why I think... I'm really glad you 
two met.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Sensei...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Teaching me about 'management' and 
'maintenance' back then..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, truly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text: ......You've really grown big.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You have truly... grown into someone 
splendid.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —We have arrived.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a place where I used to run 
often.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day after meeting Ikuno Dictus's 
former mentor. She brought me to her 
favorite spot in her hometown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a refreshing spot with a panoramic 
view. Running here must feel absolutely 
wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Whenever I come here, I always remember.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That day when I learned the joy of 
running. ...The very origin of who I am 
today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Feelings that haven't changed since that 
day... As long as I can run, I want to run 
as far as I can—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I... still want to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I want to run much, much longer...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Using 'management' and 'maintenance' to 
the fullest... I want to keep running for 
as long as I possibly can――"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However... I believe there is only so much 
one can do alone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...That's why—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I want to continue running together with 
you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, from now on... I want you to keep 
being my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As long as you are by my side, I feel 
like... I can truly run anywhere, no 
matter how far.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
……I know full well that this is a 
completely selfish request. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list:
As long as you want me to, I want to be 
your trainer.

As long as you want me to, I want to be 
your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The moment I passed through the gates of 
Tracen Academy, I swore an oath upon this 
Trainer's badge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'To let Uma Musume run happily for as long 
as they wish.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is why, as long as she wishes to run, 
I will continue to be her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And besides.
choice_data_list:
I still haven't seen you run nearly 
enough!
I still haven't had you run nearly enough!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is another vow I have held for so 
long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I signed the contract to be 
Ikuno Dictus's trainer, there was a vow 
that remained deep in my chest—
choice_data_list:
—Because I want to keep you running longer 
than anyone else.

—Because I want to let you run longer than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as that unbreakable vow stands, I 
will say it again and again.
choice_data_list: So please, let me stay your Trainer.
So please, let me remain your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"From here on as well...―― I look forward 
to working with you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A new vow is exchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And time rolls on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Each of them begins to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Countless races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Countless prayers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stacking miracle upon miracle, reaching 
for the goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――"The future."

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, I'm getting so nervous! "IRON 
WILL"! Will I really be okay!?

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"—Condition is optimal. A healthy amount 
of tension can often lead to a great 
performance."

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"If you were looking forward to today's 
race, I recommend making the most of that 
feeling."

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text: I'll look forward to...

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. It's the race I've 
always dreamed of, so I have to enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight!! Trainer-san, I'm heading 
out!! I'll give it everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text: It's finally here...! I can run at last!

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
"A GⅠ...! Together with that living 
legend...!!"

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text: —Ikuno Dictus-san!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Yes. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~! She's completely different on the 
turf! So this is "The Umamusume Who Runs 
Longer Than Anyone Else"...!!

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
—Um! I look forward to working with you 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to race against you, 
Ikuno Dictus-san, after seeing you run 
with so many amazing Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is...... an honor.

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text: I won't lose...! Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...I won't lose either."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With all the time we have built together, 
I shall face you with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And— let us be sure to cross the finish 
line safely.

text_block_list.name: Successor to the Future
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then... shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She runs today, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running to the ends of the 
earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Longer than anyone. Stronger than anyone. 
Praying for the future――――"
